subject: Quick follow-up — should I close the loop?
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan@zenith.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T17:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap + next steps

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our 30m discovery so we are aligned and can move to next steps: 

- Goal: reduce inference cost and p99 latency for your customer-facing summarization API (target p99 < 350ms).
- Current: 3k qps peak, CPU/GPU mix, inconsistent tail latency during batch windows.
- Success metrics: 40% lower cost per token and predictable p99 under sustained load.

Notes: Ben will scope an architecture runbook (autoscaling, batching, KV cache) and I will pull together a proposal and pricing options for dedicated capacity and hosted fallbacks.

Action items / timeline:
1) Ben to share initial runbook and recommended config by 2027-04-22 (attachment: discovery-notes-zenith.pdf).
2) I will send a tailored proposal with 3 pricing options and a mutual action plan by 2027-04-25.
3) Jordan to confirm procurement/timing and any compliance requirements (SOC 2, VPC) by EOW.

Attachments: discovery-notes-zenith.pdf (summary of infra notes)

If that looks right, I can book 30m next week for Ben to walk through the runbook with your engineering leads. What day works best for you?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
From: Jordan Smith <jordan@zenith.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Patel <cto@zenith.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps

Thanks Marissa, this is great and matches what we discussed. Quick notes from our side: 

- We liked the caching and batching approach Ben outlined.
- Procurement is the gating item. We are aligning on budget for H2 and Asha is looping in finance.
- Can you include an option for a phased rollout (proof of concept -> dedicated) and an estimate for data residency/VPC work?

We should be able to give you a clearer timeline by end of next week. In the meantime, please go ahead and send the proposal.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Smith
Head of Platform, Zenith AI
jordan@zenith.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan@zenith.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-26T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up on proposal and timing

Hi Jordan,

Just bumping this — wanted to check whether procurement/finance had a sense of priority for this in H2. We sent the proposal on 2027-04-25 with three options and a phased rollout plan, and Ben is ready to walk the POC runbook with your infra team.

If timing shifted or now is not a priority, no problem — just let me know so we can plan next steps on our side. If you want, I can schedule 30m with Ben and Asha for a technical runthrough.

Thanks,
Marissa

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-01T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Closing the loop — should I close the file?

Hi Jordan,

Hope you had a good Memorial Day week. I wanted to close the loop on this thread since I havent heard back after my last note. I know procurement timelines can slip and priorities change. Quick options:

1) If this is still on the roadmap but delayed, tell me the new target quarter and I will set a reminder and keep the proposal active.
2) If you want us to pause for now, I can close the file and re-open when the timing is right.

If I dont hear back by next Friday, I will go ahead and close the file on my side — you can always reopen and I will restore the thread and proposal. Attached the proposal again for easy reference: redwood-proposal-zenith.pdf.

Thanks for the time so far — would love to re-engage when you are ready.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
Attachments: redwood-proposal-zenith.pdf
